scope: Synthetic, explicitly scoped catalog envelopes and canonical reference tuples. Client helpers issue GET only; no reservation, binding, grant, Test or Finish is performed.

antecedent.observed: Malformed wire IDs escaped as ValueError (five); null scope/capabilities escaped as AttributeError (two). Source owner fixed structured refusal; tests retained. Four additional positive cases were added before the green run.

covered_client_behaviors: Normalized explicit ID and requested-family proposals; occupied reserved/bound/retired names participate in suffix proposals without mutating input
TTY compatible/cross-family explicit resume; choose another ID; explicit suggest; cancellation/EOF; new_connection never offers resume
All seven canonical identity selectors reject mismatch before any menu
Noninteractive paths never read stdin and cross-family conflicts do not silently switch harness
Multiple actors/hosts require exact choice, no latest heuristic
Private metadata omitted from generic collision error; binding reference is a fresh allowlisted tuple
Server/workspace scope, complete paging, drift, duplicate IDs across actors/hosts, cursor cycles and malformed envelopes fail closed
Old Server capability errors request upgrade; forbidden remains forbidden; no local namespace substitute
limits: Not proof of server-side uniqueness, cross-host transactions, tombstones, authorization filtering, receipt recovery or reservation concurrency
Not real TTY/PTY, CLI JSON output, installed package, remote host or provider execution
Exact profile-to-reference resolution and saved intent recovery remain integration responsibilities
No full E/F/G/I matrix promotion; evidence is a helper-level subset
